narrative: Twenty-two shillings in silver, in two small stacks, beside Sunday's unfolded letter. Candle. A hand at the edge of the frame, not a face. The pane is dark and wet. No snow.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set the coins down and left the letter open.

entities.name: the twenty-two shillings
entities.context: In photo: Silver beside the leaf
